inlineData.component_title: Unemployment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi
inlineData.component_subtitle:
This indicator measures the unemployment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Unemployment rate: It represents persons who are unemployed as a percentage of the labour force (15-64 years)

security.label: Open
security.name: 0 - Open
security.description: Data that is authorized for direct access without restrictions.

policy_guide: 1 - The above data reflects a quarterly labor force survey (according to the used methodology) that counts all persons who are 15+ and are usual residents of the emirate, regardless of where they work.

2 - The Statistics Center - Abu Dhabi is currently working on the procedure of updating the time series statistics, to comply with the results of the 2023 Census, and the updated time series of these statistics will be published after the completion of this procedure to ensure accuracy and reliability.

3 - The forecasts produced for the reference period are generated using historical data collected prior to the start of the reference period. Therefore, any activities or policies that may have contributed to changes in values during the forecasted period are not considered in these projections.

metaData.label: Indicator name
metaData.value: Unemployment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually

metaData.label: Indicator description
metaData.value: This indicator measures the unemployment rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Unemployment rate: It represents persons who are unemployed as a percentage of the labour force (15-64 years)

metaData.label: Statistical population
metaData.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metaData.label: Geographic coverage
metaData.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metaData.label: Statistical calculation method
metaData.value: [Unemployed persons resident in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually / Labour force residing in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually] x 100

aiRecommendation.title: Sustain Policy Efforts to Keep Unemployment on a Downward Trajectory
aiRecommendation.title_ar: الحفاظ على الجهود السياسية لإبقاء البطالة في مسارها التنازلي
aiRecommendation.text: With unemployment declining steadily since 2021, continued investment in skills development, job matching, and targeted programmes for youth and Emiratis will be key to maintaining this trend.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: مع الانخفاض المتواصل في معدلات البطالة منذ عام 2021، سيكون الاستثمار المستمر في تنمية المهارات ومطابقة الوظائف والبرامج الموجهة للشباب والمواطنين مفتاحاً للحفاظ على هذا الاتجاه.
aiRecommendation.reason: Unemployment rates have fallen consistently from 2021 to 2024, reflecting improvements in labour market conditions. Sustaining this progress will require targeted workforce development and active employment policies.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: انخفضت معدلات البطالة باستمرار من عام 2021 إلى عام 2024، مما يعكس تحسناً في أوضاع سوق العمل. سيتطلب استدامة هذا التقدم تنمية القوى العاملة الموجهة وسياسات التوظيف الفاعلة.
